overlap_rationale: Three independently trained skills match the three demonstrated physical responsibilities: articulated drawer pull, red open-pad transfer, and blue confined-cavity insertion. Adjacent overlap is deliberately much longer than the 8-action execution chunk and 16-slot prediction horizon: open_drawer/red_transfer share 240 actions (12.0 s) per trajectory, and red_transfer/blue_insert share 250 actions (12.5 s) per trajectory. The shared indices are action supervision, not merely observation context. They preserve release, retreat, approach, contact, close, and initial lift on both handoffs, which is expected to reduce timing sensitivity under causal history across switches. All actions in every authorized trajectory are assigned to at least one skill; no overall actions are excluded. Terminal release/retreat/hold actions are retained because they provide a stable successful endpoint, while the supplied success definition remains unchanged.
